{{Quote|I need a Nolarian 6000 drill immediately.''"<br />"''Don't have one. There's a shortage. And the way the mining safety committee has been watching us, there will be for a good while.|Doctor Lundi and a machinery dealer|<ref name="TF" />}}
A '''Nolarian 6000 drill''' was a large piece of [[Water/Legends|subaquatic]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] equipment sold on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nolar]].<ref name="TF" /> In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> there was a shortage of these [[Drill/Legends|drills]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Murk Lundi]] attempted to purchase a Nolarian 6000 drill while trying to recover a [[Holocron of King Adas|Sith Holocron]], only to have the [[Unidentified machinery dealer|dealer]] inform him of the shortage and that the [[mining safety committee]] was watching the situation.<ref name="TF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nolarian 6000 drill was mentioned in the [[2002]] young readers novel ''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]'', written by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="TF" />
